description: Company standard for application object/file storage. Use GCS — not local disk for persistent uploads, not AWS S3, not Azure Blob for new work.

project.description: GCP project ID that owns the buckets. Required in .env / .env.example (no secrets).
project.notes: Use the application or shared platform GCP project agreed for this environment (dev/stg/prod).

buckets.policy: Use a single bucket env var GCS_BUCKET. Do not hardcode the bucket name in source. Document it in .env.example with a placeholder value only.

folders.defaultRationale: The deployment platform provisions object storage with the folder {appname}/ inside the bucket. Defaulting GCS_FOLDER to the application id — the git remote's repo name, the same value the platform uses — makes the app's own object keys agree with the layout the platform actually created. A mismatch is not an error the platform reports; it just silently writes outside the provisioned prefix.
folders.description: GCS_FOLDER is the default folder (object-key prefix) inside GCS_BUCKET where the app stores files. Objects live under gs://{GCS_BUCKET}/{GCS_FOLDER}/... by default. The app may append further sub-paths within that folder.
guidance: Always set GCS_FOLDER — it is the default storage location inside the bucket

Default it to the application id (the git remote's repo name), matching the {appname}/ folder the platform provisions; only diverge when the user has a stated reason, and say what the platform provisioned
Do not store app files at the bucket root; use GCS_FOLDER as the base path
Never put secrets in object paths
Sanitize user-controlled path segments (no .., no absolute paths)

forbidden: Long-lived service account JSON key files in the repo or Secret as mounted key
Passing keyFilename / credentials JSON to Storage in production GKE

nodeLibrary.notes: Authenticate via Application Default Credentials (GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or workload identity). Use a lazily-created Storage singleton cached on globalThis to avoid leaking clients across hot reloads (mirrors db.ts). On GKE with WIF, omit keyFilename and leave GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS unset. See templates/gcs-client.ts and data/wif-gke.json.
